scope: Historical B fixed-output development studies, not new HORIZON runs or natural-generation quality evidence. Interpretations are limited to the documented interventions.

rows.heading: ## 尾段预留固定1024输出 ABBA：排除输出量后，停止当前机制
rows.observation: ACK-to-allocation failures disappeared; whole-service effects changed sign across the two pairs.
rows.explanation: Holding the target history did not prevent its preemption during residual computation; peer growth remained outside the reservation.

rows.heading: ### 2026-10-08 预算1/8实际对照：更短局部间隔，重复抢占与长请求代价
rows.observation: All 16 bypasses produced output then re-preempted; selected short requests improved while bypassed long requests waited longer.
rows.explanation: Short recovery pulses divided gaps but did not sustain service; fewer request-seconds of recovery did not imply faster completion.

rows.heading: ## 修正版重试门控 r03：一次真实完成释放，反序零动作
rows.observation: One 74 ms wait ended at a real completion; the second candidate run had no qualifying action.
rows.explanation: The action population was narrow and mean differences preceded intervention; stable whole-service benefit was not established.

rows.heading: ## 新主机ACK最多两轮实际结果：r05
rows.observation: Two breaks crossed ACK, but the target emitted only one token before another preemption.
rows.explanation: A different running request exhausted capacity through decode growth; earlier ACK access did not provide continuing headroom.

rows.heading: ## 去重复动作价值探针：实际LOAD减少，但完整流畅度变坏（2026-10-08）
rows.observation: Removing repeated bypasses reduced LOAD traffic but increased maxgap P99 by 35.6 and 33.1 percent.
rows.explanation: Repeated outputs had split long gaps; suppressing those useful service pulses traded away smoothness without stable completion gains.

rows.heading: ## 受控长目标交换：实际一token服务，随后等待回迁（2026-10-09完整结果）
rows.observation: One controlled exchange produced one target token, then re-preemption; donor flow increased by 4.31 s.
rows.explanation: Initial T/R/G covered entry but missed later peer growth. Costs shifted to the donor and peers; one active run is not replicated evidence.
